statement: Pinned hid-nintendo packages subcommands as output 0x01 with incremented packet counter and eight encoded rumble bytes, waits for matching 0x21 reply subcommand ID, and retries once after a timed-out synchronous send.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Host driver retry/ack policy; packet send success and source policy are not measured device response reliability.
